extDesc.message: Voice-to-text input for any web page using the Web Speech API, with selectable alternatives.

pickerTargetGone.message: Target field is no longer available.

errLangNotSupported.message: Language not supported by your browser.

errMicHintPrompt.message: Click the microphone icon next to the address bar to allow access on this site.

errMicHintDenied.message: Microphone is blocked for this site. Click the icon next to the address bar and reset the permission.

optMaxAlternativesHint.message: Number of candidate results to request. The browser may return fewer alternatives than you request. When set to 1, the result is inserted directly without showing the picker.

optAutoInsertIfSingle.message: Auto-insert when only one alternative is returned

optContinuousHint.message: Keep listening until you stop manually. Not recommended for input-helper UX.

optInterimResultsHint.message: Display partial transcriptions while you speak. May feel noisy in the picker.

optResetHint.message: Restore all options to their default values. This will overwrite your current settings.

optResetConfirm.message: Reset all settings to their defaults? Your current settings will be overwritten.

optReplacementsHint.message: Before recognized text is inserted or shown in the picker, these plain-text replacement rules are applied in order.

optExportSettingsHint.message: Export a JSON settings file containing the current settings and shortcut information.

optImportSettingsHint.message: Import a VoiceInput JSON settings file. Chrome may require you to confirm shortcuts manually.

optSettingsImportedShortcutUnsupported.message: Settings imported. Chrome does not support restoring shortcuts directly from an extension; confirm them manually on the shortcuts page.

optSettingsImportedShortcutPartial.message: Settings imported, but some shortcuts could not be restored. Confirm them manually on the shortcuts page.

optSettingsImportFailed.message: The settings file format is invalid and could not be imported.

optAboutPrivacyText.message: VoiceInput does not collect or send your voice, recognized text, or page content through its own servers. Settings are stored only in Chrome storage. Speech recognition is handled by the browser Web Speech API and may be subject to your browser or operating system service terms and privacy policy.

optShortcutsHint.message: Configure the toggle shortcut on Chrome's extensions shortcuts page.

popupHint.message: Tip: focus a field first, then press the shortcut.

permDesc.message: Click the button below to grant microphone access. You only need to do this once.

permGranted.message: Microphone enabled. You can close this tab.

permDenied.message: Permission denied. Please update your browser settings.
